params.description: Filtering is available for this endpoint. See [Filtering](/docs/api/pxm/files/get-all-files#filtering).

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: The maximum number of records per page for this response. You can set this value up to 100. If no page size is set, the the [**page length**](/docs/commerce-cloud/global-project-settings/settings-overview#page-length) store setting is used.

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: The current offset by number of records, not pages. Offset is zero-based. The maximum records you can offset is 10,000. If no page size is set, the [**page length**](/docs/commerce-cloud/global-project-settings/settings-overview#page-length) store setting is used.

items.docs:
Retrieves all files.

### Filtering

For general filtering syntax, see [Filtering](/guides/Getting-Started/filtering).

The following operators and attributes are available when filtering on this endpoint.

| Attribute             | Type      | Operators           | Example |
|:----------------------|:----------|:--------------------------|:-------------|
| `id`                  | `string`  | `in`                      | `in(id,file-id-1,file-id-2,file-id-3)` |
| `file_name`           | `string`

params.name: fileID
params.description: The unique identifier for a file.

params.name: fileID
params.description: The unique identifier of the file you want to delete.
